cohort: 2399 full-term (>37 weeks of gestation) newborns without induced delivery, elective cesarean section, or major pregnancy risk factors, born in a Spanish public hospital
finding: Epidural analgesia during labor was associated with slightly lower Apgar scores, increased neonatal intensive care unit admissions, more frequent resuscitation, and delayed breastfeeding onset.
mod_finding: Neonates whose mothers received epidural analgesia during labor had slightly lower Apgar scores, more frequent NICU admissions and resuscitation, and a delay in early breastfeeding onset.
